sleepiness and body mass index are associated with food patterns in children with psychopathic disorders, including ADHD.

the role of sleep in children with ADHD.
the relationship between sleep and alertness, and eating behaviors, and their impact on the development of obesity and obesity-related diseases.

sleepiness and BMI are associated with sleep schedules in children with ADHD.

the sleepiness and variability of children with ADHD and other comorbid problems are associated with sleep schedules, alertness, and food patterns.
sleepiness, sleep, and food patterns are highly variable from day-to-day and that these variables are inter-related.
